Milestone 4 case-level fixtures — what a specific (synthetic) patient's testing found, as opposed to facts about a single variant. See clinical.py and models/clinical_case.py. Every variant_id referenced here must exist in variant_evidence.json. karyotypic_sex is set to XX for the three CAPN3 cases purely because the model requires a value; it plays no role in autosomal recessive reasoning.

Batch 31 adds three BRCA1 (autosomal dominant) cases, exercising interpret_dominant_case() for the first time: a RISK_CONFERRING positive path (synthetic pathogenic single variant), an INSUFFICIENT negative path (synthetic benign single variant), and a MANUAL_REVIEW path grounded in a real variant (BRCA1_c.181T>G / C61G) whose real ENIGMA-panel Pathogenic call this project's variant-only engine cannot reach (see that fixture's notes in variant_evidence.json). karyotypic_sex is set to XX for all three purely because the model requires a value, same convention as the CAPN3 cases -- AD reasoning in interpret_dominant_case does not branch on sex.

cases.phase_evidence_note: Synthetic: variant 01 confirmed on the paternal allele, variant 02 on the maternal allele via parental testing.
Synthetic: both variants confirmed on the same (paternal) allele via parental testing; the maternal allele is unaffected.
Synthetic: parental samples were not available for testing.

SYNTHETIC case (batch 29): a hypothetical patient wired to two REAL, already-curated DMD nonsense variants (DMD_c.2302C>T and DMD_c.8944C>T, both real ClinVar-grounded, both LIKELY_PATHOGENIC), confirmed in trans via hypothetical parental testing. No real published case combining these two specific variants in one patient was found -- real published biallelic-XX-DMD cases are CNV-based or CNV+point-mutation mixes (Ulm et al. 2022, Molecular Genetics & Genomic Medicine 11:e2088; Takeshita et al. 2017; Fujii et al. 2009), which don't fit this project's point-mutation-only ClinicalCase model -- so the CASE here is synthetic while the underlying variant evidence is real, same pattern already used by CASE_DMD_FEMALE_CARRIER_REAL. See clinical.py's _interpret_xx_biallelic docstring for the real mechanism this demonstrates.

SYNTHETIC case (batch 29): same two real variants as CASE_DMD_XX_BIALLELIC_TRANS, but confirmed in cis instead -- both on the same X chromosome copy, leaving the other X copy genuinely wild-type. Deliberately paired with the TRANS case to demonstrate that this does NOT resolve to INSUFFICIENT the way autosomal recessive cis does: a wild-type X copy can still be silenced by X-inactivation in some cells, so the real phenotype unpredictability found in Brioschi et al. 2012 (already cited for the single-carrier case) still applies. See clinical.py's _interpret_xx_biallelic docstring.
